chunks: It is He who first creates and then reverts it. This is how His law works inevitably. His semblance is of the most sublime in the heavens and the earth. He is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's ability to recreate creation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ease of resurrection (al-Ba'th) for Allah, countering human skepticism by linking the initial creation (al-Bada') with the return. The phrase 'For Him is the highest description' (Lahu al-Mathal al-A'la) is often interpreted as affirming His absolute perfection without comparison, a key concept in Usuli theology regarding divine attributes. This reinforces the logical coherence of the Hereafter as a natural extension of divine power rather than a miraculous anomaly.
